NOTES:
----------
* = Dave solo
^ = Dave & Carter
~ = Dave & Boyd

This is the Charlottesville Remember Two Things Release Party.

This has the last full performance of Heathcliff's Haiku Warriors. Dave only played it in full 3 times (the others on 03/23 and 07/06/93...plus a few teases).

Warehouse has some alternate lyrics in the begining of the song.

There are a few spots of static in Ants.

The start of Jimi Thing is missing, plus there is a 4 sec dropout at the end of the song.

There is some skipping and static at the end of True Reflections.

These rare older shows have been collected and converted through a collaborative effort to get them into circulation. Sometimes these shows do not have the best sound quality (and maybe that's why they aren't circulated much to begin with), but people should have access to them. 

Thanks to Dan Pyrik for the CD source used for the conversion. 

Compiled By Adam Nelson on November 9, 2006 (Hey it's the 13th anniversery of this show!)


Reconversion notes:
-------------------
Reviewed this source I received from Adam. The tape had problems on other tracks so there was a lot more fixing up to do. Using Soundforge 8, applied pencil tool to tracks affected by static spikes.  Other errors fixed as noted below.  Created new flac files and fingerprints using Flac Frontend. 

Errors fixed:
-------------
Static at 7:41-7:42 & 7:45 of OSW
Left channel intermittent dropoff between 1:33 & 1:48, 5:16 to 5:34 and 6:14 to 6:38 of Nancies, copied right channel  
Static from 5:57 to 6:14 of True Reflections,static removed but skips like a broken record remain. Probably present on the cd source due to dirt or scratches and not the original DAT.
Static at 5:03 of Christmas Song, applied crossfade since a dropout was there after removing static
Static at 2:18,2:20-2:21 & 2:23-2:24 of Ants
Dropout at 9:54 of Jimi, applied crossfade over 4 second period to make more seamless

Recompiled and reconverted by Tom Gambichler on January 18, 2010

---------------------------------------

Fixed-v2 by Henry Hart December 5/6, 2021:

Fixed the speed/pitch issues (extended the length of the recording my roughly 5 minutes
Significant bass lift for improved audio
Notch filtered out the analog line noise
Deleted the tracking blips at the start of each song
Amplified the whole show by several dB
Blended the gap between Lie In Our Graves and Dancing Nancies
Fade out
